game.title: Tennessee Titans at New York Giants

lede: New York Giants carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#15 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it New York Giants -7.6 with a fair total of 44.4, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Tennessee Titans pass offence vs New York Giants pass defence, which sits −0.178 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
